description: Defines an immutable data model class 'BudgetModel' representing budget allocations in a financial app, with properties for id, categoryId, limitAmount, usedAmount, and computed properties for remaining amount and exceeded status. Includes a copyWith method for creating modified copies.

classes.name: BudgetModel
classes.description: Immutable class representing a budget for a category, with properties and methods to manage budget data and check if limits are exceeded.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the BudgetModel with optional new properties, facilitating immutability and state updates.
